criteria.text: After I approve in chat, `pdd approve PATH --said "yes, go ahead"` approves that prompt without a terminal and reports its current prose hash.
Absent --said keeps terminal y/N; empty, whitespace-only or missing --said values never approve or change a file.
Root `pdd.json` with `strict_approvals: true` refuses chat approval and requires a person terminal; missing or false keeps easy mode.
Every successful approval durably records the invoking actor, time, route, verbatim words and prompt path/hash; unrelated prompt bytes stay unchanged.

cases.given: draft valid prompt; agent/no TTY; said = " yes, go ahead\n@person #17 `words` "
cases.required_observation: exit 0, approved/current hash; exact other bytes; journal said/agent/clock/verbatim words/path/hash

cases.given: missing option value, empty, whitespace, duplicate said; separately no said and piped y
cases.required_observation: exit 2, no prompt/journal changes; absent option on a real person TTY still asks y/N

cases.given: root pdd.json true; said with TTY and yes; separately no-said agent; separately real person TTY y and n
cases.required_observation: said/agent refuse with terminal request; person y approves with terminal evidence, n leaves unchanged

cases.given: nested cwd, linked worktree sourceRoot with true; absent/false; malformed JSON/string/null/unreadable config
cases.required_observation: trusted root policy wins; invalid config refuses before writes; missing/false easy

cases.given: two native processes approve different prompts sharing commonDir; existing malformed journal; write/rename failure
cases.required_observation: successful concurrent evidence survives; invalid existing journal unchanged; failure never reports success

cases.given: CODEX_THREAD_ID plus PDD_AGENT_SESSION=1; each marker fallback; USER, LOGNAME, none; fixed clock; standalone approval before workflow PR
cases.required_observation: concrete Codex session wins over generic workflow marker, Claude marker beats generic fallback; exact time/words saved and matching path/hash published; later prose invalidates association

cases.given: schema/hash/nested status guards; invalid/symlink/deleted path; stale prose; already current; presentAndApprove Simulator caller
cases.required_observation: existing safeguards and exports retain behavior; only named top-level values change; already current no-op

cases.given: no --said, both stdin/stdout TTY, agent markers present; repeat with strict_approvals true
cases.required_observation: easy mode asks y/N and y approves with markers preserved; strict mode refuses marked TTY; original prompt safeguards and unrelated bytes remain unchanged
